en.title: 'Photographing Distance' exhibition opens in Jeddah
en.summary: Argentinian artist Matilde Marin's exhibition featuring photographs and videos of lighthouses worldwide opened at the Red Sea Museum in Jeddah, running until December 31. The display explores lighthouses as symbols of navigation and human memory, including structures from Jeddah and Yanbu.

en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Council of Economic and Development Affairs reviewed economic developments amid geopolitical tensions, noting global inflationary pressures and central bank monetary tightening. The council assessed implications and opportunities for the Saudi economy.

en.summary: Saudi Central Bank Governor Ayman Al-Sayari cautioned that prolonged regional conflict could worsen global inflation and disrupt supply chains, while noting Saudi Arabia maintains economic strength despite geopolitical challenges.

stories.title: Saudi private sector growth accelerates despite regional tensions, economic council says

en.title: Saudi private sector growth accelerates despite regional tensions, economic council says
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's private sector expanded in August 2026 with the Purchasing Managers' Index rising to 53.8 from 53.1 in July, marking five consecutive months of growth. Business confidence also increased to 56.7 despite regional tensions and global inflationary pressures.

stories.title: ‎GACA: 3 killed in attacks on Riyadh airport, Saudia aircraft

en.title: GACA: 3 killed in attacks on Riyadh airport, Saudia aircraft
en.summary: Two attacks targeted King Khalid International Airport on October 8, 2026, with one striking airport facilities and another damaging a parked Saudia aircraft. Three Saudi nationals were killed and multiple people injured, with material damage also reported.

stories.title: ‎30 Million Umrah Pilgrims.. But Who Owns the Journey?

en.title: 30 Million Umrah Pilgrims.. But Who Owns the Journey?
en.summary: Saudi Arabia received 18.03 million Umrah pilgrims from abroad in 2025 against a 2030 target of 30 million, though only 12.44 million of the 15.03 million visas issued were specifically for Umrah purposes. The discrepancy raises questions about market composition.

stories.title: ‎Gold, silver prices rise as dollar, treasury yields fall

en.title: Gold, silver prices rise as dollar, treasury yields fall
en.summary: Gold and silver prices increased on Friday as the US dollar weakened and Treasury yields fell amid geopolitical uncertainty. Spot silver gained 2.30% to $60.52 per ounce while the Dollar Index declined 0.15%.

en.title: Oil prices fall over 1%
en.summary: US WTI crude futures for November delivery dropped 1.35% to $90.25 per barrel on Friday, driven by eased Middle East supply concerns following Trump's statement against attacking Iran before elections, despite new US sanctions on Iranian oil transporters.
